notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.30.0: feeds the runtime's fetch couldn't reach (root-path CloudFront hosts, TLS 1.2-only CDNs) now load.

win.notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.39.1. What that brings on Windows: shipped apps no longer carry a reachable inspector (F12 devtools are opt-in now), WebView2’s own browser shortcuts — Ctrl+P print preview, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+R/F5 — no longer fire under the app, a greyed-out menu item keeps its accelerator instead of leaking it to the page, file pickers can filter by type and Save appends the extension, and a throw inside an app handler no longer takes the whole app down.
